design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix warm artisanal bakery tones (warm cream, clay, deep terracotta) with high-speed modern e-commerce pre-order micro-interactions.
Scheduling First UX: The delivery date picker is an integrated hero banner and step 1 of checkout. Clear notice that items are baked/cooked fresh sob encomenda.

Contrast and Micro-Textures: Use subtle warm borders (1px border-amber-200/60), gentle shadows (shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300), and crisp badge indicators.
Accessibility & State Highlighting: Explicit hover/active text colors. Never use generic blue or raw black. Use warm dark chocolate (#2C1A0E) for high contrast text.
Zero Account Friction: Express checkout with full customer detail capture (name, phone, address) and simulated instant payment options.

pre_order_banner.description: Interactive date picker at top of catalog allowing customer to select target delivery date. Highlights lead-time (e.g. 'Pedindo hoje, entregamos a partir de amanhã').

catalog_and_filters.search: Instant text filter with badge highlights (Mais Pedidos, Novidade, Vegano)

product_modal.features: Photo gallery zoom, customizable options (molhos extras, observações, quantidade), minimum quantity notice for party combos.

cart_drawer.contents: Scheduled date summary banner, item list with quantity steppers (+/-), delivery address quick preview, promo voucher input, total breakdown, clear CTA button 'Avançar para Agendamento & Pagamento'.

steps: 1. Dados da Entrega: Nome completo, Telefone (WhatsApp), Endereço completo (Rua, Número, Bairro, CEP, Complemento)
2. Agendamento da Entrega: Calendar component with valid future delivery dates and time slot choice (Manhã 09h-12h, Tarde 14h-18h, Noite 18h-21h)
3. Pagamento Simulado: Choice between Pix (QR Code + Copia e Cola), Cartão de Crédito (Form simulado), Cartão de Débito (Form simulado), Vale/Pluxee Refeição (Número do Cartão)

order_confirmation.features: Animated checkmark, order code (ex: #ENC-9482), summary of scheduled date and time slot, simulated Pix copy button if Pix selected, simulated WhatsApp update link, button to view order status.

admin_dashboard.route: Accessible via toggle or header button 'Painel Admin'
tabs: Encomendas Agendadas (View incoming orders filtered by delivery date, update status: Pendente, Em Preparo, Pronto, Em Rota, Entregue)
Gerenciar Cardápio (Add, edit, delete snacks, toggle availability, edit price, upload image URL)

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive input, button, select, tab, modal, and key text element MUST contain data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application in JavaScript (.js and .jsx files). Do not create TypeScript .tsx files unless explicitly configured.
Ensure all components use data-testid for all clickable and key content areas.
Implement Sonner toasts for cart additions, order submission, copying Pix key, and admin actions.
Use clean localStorage persistence for orders and cart so page reloads do not wipe data during testing or usage.
Make the delivery date picker prominent both on the catalog hero header (to set delivery expectation) and inside the checkout flow.
Admin panel must allow creating new items with image URL, price, category, description, and lead time.
Include sample seed data for at least 8 appetizing snacks so the store immediately looks populated and delicious.
